selection: First complete beam group in printed system/measure/onset order with exactly two single-head sixteenth notes, two full beams, explicit head-stem and all beam-stem edges, no curve/articulation/fermata/flag/dot/alter attachment. Single printed measure, matched source events only. Do not replace the selected group after rendered results.
scope: A bounded atomic group, NOT a complete measure. Display entire original measure separately; list all excluded events. Chords/lyrics never reconstructed. Controls remain entire measures 3 and 32.
geometry: Reuse unchanged GT05 raster glyph placement and frozen absolute semantic pitch targets. Stem side from explicit head-stem relation; keep original primary beam slope, source secondary-beam separation and thickness. Re-anchor beam endpoints at rendered stem x; choose vertical intercept so shortest stem reaches at least 3.5 staff interlines. All beams connect to all stems; partial beams/hooks unsupported.
stroke: 2 px stems/staff/ledgers as GT05; beam thickness rounded from persisted beam geometry, no score-image fitting
checks: all required semantic events and beam levels
actual raster head/stem and every stem/beam contact
protected envelope and source-dark-ink contacts separately
unchanged historical controls and source hashes
reference_policy: Freeze all predictions and hashes before reference comparison; no reference data used in selection or placement. Diagnostic development comparison only, no accepted human denominator.
stop: Unsupported required notation blocks group. Failed geometry/collision checks remain NEEDS_REFINEMENT, never substitute another excerpt.
